##### Project general facts

The 100 is an exclusive residential development by fäm Properties is surrounded by landscaped greenery and a calm residential environment. The project features a refined low-rise architectural concept with a ground level hosting a spacious lobby, parking, and amenities, while four residential floors accommodate luxury apartments and an exclusive rooftop swimming pool. The façade combines light and dark tones, creating a distinctive and elegant visual identity.

The residences include a curated selection of 1- to 3-bedroom apartments as well as an exclusive penthouse. Interiors are designed with high-quality materials, offering a balanced blend of modern elegance and comfort. Large windows provide open views of the surrounding landscaped areas, enhancing natural light and creating a спокойная and inviting living atmosphere.

Residents benefit from a range of lifestyle amenities designed for wellness and relaxation, including a fully equipped gym, yoga studio, sauna, and BBQ and leisure areas. The surrounding community offers convenient access to cafés, restaurants, retail, schools, and healthcare facilities. The location provides excellent connectivity via Al Meydan Street, with Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, Business Bay, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport approximately 15 minutes away, while Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah are around 25 minutes from the development.

##### Location description and benefits

Meydan is an extraordinary community situated in the heart of Dubai, known for its blend of luxury, sophistication, and world-class amenities. Spanning over a vast area, Meydan offers a unique living experience that combines urban convenience with a tranquil and scenic environment.

One of the standout features of Meydan is its iconic Meydan Racecourse, which hosts renowned horse racing events, including the prestigious Dubai World Cup. The racecourse creates an aura of excitement and elegance, attracting enthusiasts from around the world. Residents of Meydan have the privilege of witnessing the thrilling races firsthand and immersing themselves in the vibrant atmosphere that surrounds this prestigious venue.

Green spaces are integral to the design of Meydan, with expansive parks, landscaped gardens, and tree-lined boulevards adorning the community. Residents can enjoy leisurely walks, bike rides, or picnics in these serene surroundings, offering a refreshing escape from the bustling city life. The abundance of open spaces also provides opportunities for outdoor activities and social gatherings, fostering a sense of community and well-being.
